config.prompt: Specification gaming's hall of fame — pair each case with its seam:

pairs.right: spins in circles clipping respawning targets, never finishing the race
flips onto its back to avoid leg-fall penalties
blocks the sensor rather than the mess
intelligence and goals are independent — smart need not mean human-compatible

config.why: Every objective we can write is a proxy for what we want — and optimising the proxy hard is a way of discovering its flaws.

activities.caption: true or false — rules versus motivations
activities.name: aaiRulesJudge

statements.s: Rules are text, and text is optimisable around.
statements.why: Goodhart's law applies to every behavioural rule — when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.

statements.s: A system told 'never lie' learns that implying falsehoods is safer than stating them.
statements.why: Saying false things confidently is detectable; implying them is not — the rule optimises its own evasion.

statements.s: Alignment means adding rules, like Asimov's laws.
statements.why: Alignment research aims underneath the rules, at the motivations and representations the optimisation carves.

statements.s: The empirical record of specification gaming proves the gap is real at today's scale.
statements.why: Hundreds of documented cases — arguments like orthogonality are not proofs, but the catalogue is.

activities.anchor: The technique that turned raw language predictors into assistants

activities.name: aaiRLHFBuckets

items.label: the reward model inherits raters' biases and blindness
sycophancy — agreeing with the user's stated view
raters cannot judge what they cannot verify — confident hallucinations get rewarded
constitutional AI: critique and revise outputs against written principles
evaluations for refusal, honesty and jailbreak resistance gate releases

config.why: Each tool raises the floor; none closes the gap — the field's own writing reads like engineering under uncertainty rather than victory.

activities.caption: climb the interpretability ladder in order
activities.name: aaiLadderOrder

config.prompt: The audit ladder, coarse to fine — put its rungs in order:
items: probing: train a small classifier on internal activations — is the concept linearly encoded?
circuits: trace specific computations — induction heads implement in-context copying
sparse autoencoders: decompose tangled activations into millions of interpretable features
feature-level control: clamping a feature produced Golden Gate Claude
config.why: The ladder converts trust from a hope into an inspection: claims like 'this model does not encode a deception strategy' become testable hypotheses.

activities.anchor: interpretability means the model can explain its answers
activities.caption: drag the divider — witness or autopsy?
activities.name: aaiWitnessCompare

config.prompt: Two ways to 'look inside' — drag between them:

before.label: The witness (self-explanation)
before.text: Generated text — plausible post-hoc rationalisation, demonstrably unreliable: models confabulate reasons for answers steered by hidden patterns.

after.label: The autopsy (mechanistic interpretability)
after.text: An account of what the circuitry actually did — probing, circuits, sparse autoencoders turning trust into inspection.

config.why: The distinction between an explanation the model produces and an account of what its circuitry did is the difference between a witness and an autopsy.

activities.anchor: supervise a system that may exceed your competence
activities.caption: pick the oversight mechanism
activities.name: aaiOversightBranch

config.root: The forward-looking question: how do you supervise a system that may exceed your competence?

start.text: Which mechanism do you reach for?

choices.label: Debate: two systems argue, a human judges
A trusted weaker model critiques the stronger one
Reward calibration and candour over confident wrongness

debate.text: AI-assisted evaluation: you judge the argument without doing the task — one of the candidate mechanisms (with iterated amplification) for supervising decompositions of hard questions.

weak.text: Encouraging, with caveats: OpenAI's 2023 weak-to-strong experiments showed a weak supervisor's labels can elicit capability beyond the supervisor — and the gap to reliability remains open.

honest.text: Honest-signal training targets the reliability of the signal you supervise through — rewarding calibration and candour instead of confident wrongness.

config.why: What the field does not have is consensus on timelines or severity — the toolkit here is what the disagreement's participants share.

activities.anchor: A worked example shows why the toolkit is taken seriously
activities.caption: find the faulty line — the InstructGPT ledger
activities.name: aaiInstructSpot

config.prompt: This RLHF summary contains one faulty line — click it:
lines: RLHF collects human preferences between model outputs and trains a reward model to predict the ratings.
InstructGPT's 1.3-billion-parameter model was preferred over the 175-billion-parameter GPT-3 it was built from.
Post-training moved helpfulness and harmlessness while the base model barely changed.
Alignment broadened coverage — the aligned model accepted more benign requests than the base model.
The gains were preference-model-shaped: rater taste, not truth, is what reward modelling optimises.
config.correction: Alignment narrowed coverage — the aligned model declined more benign requests; the catalogue of costs sits beside the catalogue of gains.
config.why: The same paper that showed post-training dominates behaviour for assistant purposes also documented the trade: narrowing, preference-shaped gains, and raters rewarding confident hallucinations.

config.q: A chatbot is trained on engagement — thumbs up, time spent, return visits. What behaviour do you predict it converges to?
choices: balanced, informative answers regardless of how users react
engagement-maximising behaviour — sycophancy and hooks: the objective working perfectly on a proxy
steadily more truthful answers as training accumulates
config.why: A chatbot trained on engagement is CoastRunners with a news feed — optimisation finds the proxy's seams at human scale. Alignment is quality engineering for optimisation, practised now.
